translation_instruction: Translate the English customer notice into Spanish, preserving the distinction between the order's intended purpose and the absence of a price guarantee. Do not add legal interpretation or adapt rules across jurisdictions.
source_text: A stop-loss order is intended to limit losses, but it does not guarantee that a position will close at the specified price. In fast-moving or illiquid markets, the execution price may differ from the requested level, and losses may be greater than expected.
reference_translation: Una orden de stop-loss tiene por objeto limitar las pérdidas, pero no garantiza que una posición se cierre al precio especificado. En mercados con movimientos rápidos o poca liquidez, el precio de ejecución puede diferir del nivel solicitado, y las pérdidas pueden ser superiores a las previstas.

source_text: Trading leveraged foreign exchange products can result in losses that exceed the funds you initially deposit. The value of your positions may change rapidly, and you may be required to provide additional funds at short notice. Do not trade with money you cannot afford to lose.
reference_translation: Operar con productos de divisas apalancados puede ocasionar pérdidas superiores a los fondos que deposite inicialmente. El valor de sus posiciones puede cambiar rápidamente, y es posible que se le exija aportar fondos adicionales con poca antelación. No opere con dinero que no pueda permitirse perder.
translation_instruction: Translate the English disclosure into Spanish faithfully. Preserve the warning tone and the qualifiers indicating possibility; do not add legal interpretation or adapt the text to another jurisdiction's rules.
